title: Lost Mary Maryliq Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Step into a wintry orchard with Lost Mary Maryliq's Cherry Ice, a mesmerising blend that fuses ripe, sweet Cherry with a frosty Ice finish. Each puff delivers a tantalising mix of warmth and chill, making it a perfect year-round vape. The sweet Cherry notes come to life with the invigorating Ice undertone, resulting in a well-balanced and invigorating flavour experience. Its 50% VG / 50% PG ratio promises a smooth vaping session complete with ample cloud production and a satisfying throat hit, rounding off this e-liquid as an all-around winner in the flavour department.
